clue.text: Seasoned, but looked about a hundred

indicators.note: about means going round, so the word for looked encloses the hundred

parts.note: spied means looked, kept watch
C is the Roman numeral for a hundred

explanation.surface: Someone well seasoned in years, but looking as if they were a centenarian.
explanation.definitionFit: Spiced food has been flavoured with seasonings, so the two adjectives are synonyms.

clue.text: Stubborn beast made for …

parts.note: a pig is a beast
headed means made for, went towards

explanation.surface: A stubborn animal set off towards the next clue.
explanation.walkthrough: The ellipsis carries the sentence into the next clue; it plays no part in the wordplay.
explanation.definitionFit: Pigheaded and stubborn are synonyms for obstinate.

clue.text: … elephant's mate, wholly captivated and guileless

indicators.note: captivated means held captive, so the word for wholly sits inside

parts.note: a female elephant is called a cow
all means wholly, entirely

explanation.surface: Continuing the beast story: an elephant's partner was completely charmed and innocent.
explanation.definitionFit: Callow means inexperienced and naive, close to guileless.

clue.text: Tarnish the shade of Hell?

indicators.note: of links the shade to its owner, so the word for Hell comes before the colour word

parts.note: Dis is the Roman underworld, so Hell
a colour is a shade

explanation.surface: A question about what colour the underworld is.
explanation.walkthrough: 'shade of Hell' reads backwards: the part for Hell comes first in the answer.
explanation.definitionFit: To tarnish something is to stain or change its colour, the verb.

clue.text: Meet requirements flexibly

definitions.meaning: to provide what is needed, the verb
the rare adverb from supple, meaning in a supple or pliant way

explanation.definitionFit: To provide what is needed is the verb sense; the adverb sense comes from supple, meaning in a bendy way.

clue.text: Not required to give up time to an afterthought

definitions.text: give up time to an afterthought
definitions.meaning: the verb as in to ... a thought, devoting a moment to something

explanation.definitionFit: The adjective means surplus or extra; the verb means to give, as in sparing a thought.

clue.text: Cadger takes cut as it splits

indicators.note: splits means the words as it break open the word for cut

parts.note: to pare is to cut or trim

explanation.surface: A scrounger takes a share of the proceeds as they are divided.
explanation.definitionFit: A parasite lives off others, like a cadger who scrounges.

clue.text: Popular Valentines feature a nymph

indicators.note: feature means the answer is included within these words

explanation.surface: Popular Valentine cards depict a nymph.
explanation.definitionFit: A nymph is an immature insect stage, as a larva is.

clue.text: Escorts to one performance, going back alone

parts.note: a gig is a single performance by a band

indicators.note: going back tells us to read the word for alone from right to left

parts.note: solo means alone

explanation.surface: Someone escorts a friend to a show and then returns home by themselves.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Escorts' reads as a verb but is the plural noun; 'going back' turns the word for alone around to make OLOS.
explanation.definitionFit: Gigolos are paid male escorts, so the plural noun matches the plural noun.

clue.text: Get thee hence! To Jordan?

definitions.meaning: an old dismissive phrase meaning go away
a destination in the Jordan valley, taken literally

explanation.definitionFit: An idiom meaning go away; literally, Jericho is in the Jordan valley.

clue.text: Broadcast decline in supplies from above

parts.note: to air something is to broadcast it
a drop is a decline or fall

explanation.surface: A news broadcast reports a fall in the amount of supplies arriving.
explanation.definitionFit: An airdrop is a delivery of supplies by parachute from an aircraft overhead.

clue.text: Cupid's love for exotic foods to many can be mind-blowing

parts.note: in myth Psyche was loved by Cupid
a deli sells exotic and continental foods
C, the Roman hundred, is a crossword sign for many

explanation.surface: Cupid's beloved prefers exotic dishes, which many find mind-blowing.
explanation.definitionFit: Psychedelic experiences alter perception and are literally mind-blowing.

clue.text: Kipling's skin-deep relationship with the Raj lay closed, oddly no guy involved

indicators.note: involved suggests the letters are tangled up together and rearranged

explanation.surface: A comment on Kipling's view of a hidden liaison during British rule in India.
explanation.walkthrough: Kipling's poem 'The Ladies' ends: the Colonel's Lady an' Judy O'Grady are sisters under their skins. 'involved' rearranges all of THE RAJ LAY CLOSED, ODDLY and NO GUY.
explanation.definitionFit: The pair named in Kipling's line are sisters under the skin, a kinship that goes only skin deep in difference.

clue.text: See 11
Flirty question to alien returning it in club

indicators.note: in tells us the following letters sit inside the word for club

parts.note: a cosh is a short heavy club
ET is the film alien, the extra-terrestrial

indicators.note: returning means the little word it is read backwards

explanation.surface: Someone asks a flirtatious question of an alien visitor at a nightclub.
explanation.walkthrough: 'club' suggests a nightclub but is a weapon; 'returning' reverses the little word it, giving TI.
explanation.definitionFit: Coquettish behaviour is playfully flirtatious, so the adjectives match.

clue.text: Not trampled under, don't move!

indicators.note: move tells us to shift the letters into a new order

explanation.surface: A command not to stir from underneath, to avoid being stepped on.
explanation.walkthrough: 'move' rearranges UNDER and DONT, the apostrophe dropped.
explanation.definitionFit: Untrodden ground has never been walked over, so not trampled.

clue.text: One like this still in a state of equilibrium

parts.note: I is the Roman numeral one
so means in this way, like this
static means still, not moving

explanation.surface: Something kept motionless and balanced.
explanation.definitionFit: Isostatic describes balance in the earth's crust, a state of equilibrium.

clue.text: Complaint (without date) about American spies with a twitch

indicators.note: about means the two letters go round the rest

parts.note: s.a., Latin sine anno, means without date
the CIA is the US intelligence agency
a tic is a twitch

explanation.surface: An undated ailment about American agents with a nervous twitch.
explanation.walkthrough: S.A. (sine anno) is a bibliographic note for an undated book.
explanation.definitionFit: Sciatica is a painful nerve condition, a medical complaint.

clue.text: Touching last month's talk on "How to improve our surroundings"

parts.note: re means concerning or touching on
December, abbreviated Dec, is the last month of the year
to orate is to give a talk or speech

explanation.surface: A lecture given in the previous month on home improvement.
explanation.walkthrough: 'last month' is the year's last month, not the month just gone.
explanation.definitionFit: To redecorate is to repaint or repaper rooms, making one's surroundings better.

clue.text: Cross over entrance

indicators.note: over signals turning the word for entrance around

parts.note: a door is an entrance

explanation.surface: Someone is cross about something above the doorway.
explanation.walkthrough: 'over' turns DOOR backwards. 'Cross' looks like 'angry' but is the noun.
explanation.definitionFit: A rood is a crucifix, especially one set above a church's chancel.

clue.text: Love quiet time with a good book when one is given a choice

parts.note: O is love, zero in tennis
P is piano, quiet in music
NT is the New Testament, part of the Good Book

explanation.surface: Relaxing with a novel in peace is what you do when free to choose.
explanation.definitionFit: An optant is someone who chooses, especially a nationality.

clue.text: Care centre that's not operational

parts.note: a small local hospital, usually without surgical facilities, so no operations are done there; not operational seems to mean out of action

explanation.definitionFit: A cottage hospital is a small rural hospital that traditionally offers no surgery.

clue.text: Object for beginners to take home in new gear

indicators.note: beginners are the first letters of the following words

explanation.surface: Something a novice takes home in new equipment.
explanation.definitionFit: Thing is the most general everyday noun for any physical item, a plain synonym for object.

clue.text: Disliked person putting me up in eastern city

indicators.note: in places the reversed word inside the city

parts.note: NY is New York city

indicators.note: up means me is read upwards, reversed in a down clue

explanation.surface: Someone resented for bringing the speaker to a city in the east.
explanation.walkthrough: In a down clue 'up' means read upwards, so the word me becomes EM.
explanation.definitionFit: An enemy is a hostile, disliked person.

clue.text: Opening made by reactor, if icebound

indicators.note: made by says the answer is formed from consecutive letters spanning these words

explanation.surface: An opening created by a nuclear reactor in frozen terrain.
explanation.definitionFit: An orifice is an opening, such as a mouth or vent.

clue.text: It's back in character, turning savage

indicators.note: in places the first reversed piece inside the second
turning means the word for character is reversed

parts.note: a card is a character, an eccentric person

indicators.note: back tells us to read the letters of it's in reverse

parts.note: the letters ITS, apostrophe dropped

explanation.surface: A character in a story turns savage again.
explanation.walkthrough: 'back' gives STI and 'turning' gives DRAC; STI goes inside DRAC.
explanation.definitionFit: Drastic and savage both describe severe, harsh measures.

clue.text: See 11
See the sign?

definitions.meaning: to observe or spot, the verb

explanation.definitionFit: To spot something is the verb sense; a placard or posted announcement is the noun sense.
